cornerofeye.journal.page.0:
If you are reading this, it found you too.

I don't know how many nights I have left. I'll write down what I've learned.
cornerofeye.journal.page.1:
It stands in the dark, right at the edge of your vision.

Turn to look and there is nothing there. You can only ever see it from the corner of your eye.
cornerofeye.journal.page.2:
It puts out the lights. Torches, lanterns, campfires. Only the ones you aren't looking at.

One by one, until it's dark enough.
cornerofeye.journal.page.3:
It won't step into light, and it can't touch you while you stand in it.

Glowstone doesn't burn. Neither do sea lanterns. Those it can't put out.
cornerofeye.journal.page.4:
Walls mean nothing to it.

At first it only watches. Then it comes a little closer every night.

By the seventh night it stops waiting.
cornerofeye.journal.page.5:
Where it stood, it leaves scraps. Cold, like a torn piece of shadow.

Walk to where you saw it. It won't let you get close, but the scrap will be there.
cornerofeye.journal.page.6:
Collect them while it is still only watching.

Once the hunt begins it leaves almost nothing behind.
cornerofeye.journal.page.7:
A lantern, four amethyst shards and four scraps make a Lantern of Revelation.

Hold it to charge. Let go to flash.
cornerofeye.journal.page.8:
If it is anywhere in sight when the light goes off, even at the very edge, it is caught.

Every flash burns one scrap. Don't waste them.
cornerofeye.journal.page.9:
Three times. Catch it three times and it leaves for good.

I caught it once.

It's in the corner now. I can see it.

Don't look at it.
